title: Checkout failure map
description: A sample checkout with two user journeys. Explore mandatory inventory, optional recommendations and an unresolved payment adapter. This is a synthetic source fixture, not a live system.

edges.reason: The checkout entrypoint returns createOrder directly; a rejected order operation rejects the journey.
The browse entrypoint returns browseCatalog directly.
Order creation awaits an inventory reservation. No fallback catches inventory rejection.
The catalog returns inventory.list() without a fallback; an inventory rejection propagates.
Recommendation errors are caught and replaced with an empty suggestions list. The order still completes, with fewer features.

The payment adapter is injected and absent from this fixture. The call site awaits authorize(), but does not show how a provider outage maps to an adapter response. Inspect that adapter before deciding whether this outage blocks checkout.

limitations: This is a synthetic sample, not a production architecture or a live health check.
Results follow a Boolean dependency model. They do not establish capacity, latency, outage probability, retries or recovery time.
Payment adapter behavior is unresolved. A source reference confirms a location, not the correctness of an interpretation.
The fingerprint covers only cited files at render time. It does not detect later edits or cover uncited code, runtime configuration or external services.
